title: Equity Accounting Note — What Counts against a Calendar Quarter's Class H Preferred Stock Purchase Allowance, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
What counts against the calendar quarter of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock purchase rests on the holding's other entries inside that quarter. The quarter under review runs from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026, and the reinvested dividend paid inside it is the one paid on 15 April 2026.

## Rule

- When the holding carries a reinvested dividend dated inside the quarter and no retirement dated inside it, the amount counted is the latest purchase plus that reinvested dividend, because reinvested shares use the quarter's room as purchases do.
- When the holding carries a retirement dated inside the quarter, the amount counted is the latest purchase less that retirement.
- Otherwise it is the latest purchase alone.

## Terms used

- **Latest purchase**: the purchase entry with the latest effective date on the holding.
- **Reinvested dividend dated inside the quarter**: the reinvested dividend entry paid on 15 April 2026.
- **Retirement dated inside the quarter**: the holding's latest retirement entry — of any reason — when it is dated on or after 1 April 2026 and on or before 30 June 2026; "that retirement" is its amount.

## Condition table

| Reinvested dividend of 15 April 2026 on the holding | Latest retirement dated inside the quarter | Amount counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Latest purchase plus that dividend |
| Yes | Yes | Latest purchase less that retirement |
| No | Yes | Latest purchase less that retirement |
| No | No | Latest purchase alone |

## Worked lines (hypothetical holding, latest purchase 245,000.00 dated 20 May 2026)

| Other entries | Amount counted |
|---|---|
| Reinvested dividend 9,800.00 on 15 April 2026; latest retirement dated in 2025 | 254,800.00 |
| Reinvested dividend 9,800.00 on 15 April 2026; retirement 4,000.00 dated 2 May 2026 | 241,000.00 |
| No reinvested dividend on 15 April 2026; latest retirement dated in 2025 | 245,000.00 |
